rainfall.source_name: India Meteorological Department (IMD) - Climate Research & Services, Pune
rainfall.contact: Shri Ranjan Phukan, Scientist D, +91 9435669264, ranjan.phukan@imd.gov.in
rainfall.district_wise_access: Not directly downloadable via public URLs. Requires formal request through Data Supply Portal or email contact.
rainfall.years_available: Historical archive available, but district-wise 2021-2025 requires manual request
rainfall.notes: Gridded data can be aggregated to districts using GeoJSON boundaries. No public CSV/Excel download for district-wise annual rainfall 2021-2025.

crop_production.source_name: Directorate of Economics & Statistics (DES), Ministry of Agriculture
crop_production.data_gov_in: https://data.gov.in (district-wise crop production datasets exist but require API key)
crop_production.years_available: Latest agricultural years typically 2019-2023 (varies by state)
crop_production.notes: District-wise crop production and yield data for 21 major crops. Requires data.gov.in API registration or manual download from DES publications.

soil_data.source_name: ICAR-NBSS&LUP (National Bureau of Soil Survey & Land Use Planning) & Soil Health Card Scheme
soil_data.available_formats: PDF reports, district soil maps, database access (institutional)
soil_data.district_coverage: Partial - detailed soil profiles for benchmark districts, state-level generalizations elsewhere
soil_data.notes: Actual measured soil data (NPK, pH, EC, OC, micronutrients) available only for benchmark districts. Most districts have estimated/regional values. Soil Health Card data requires state-level access.
